title: Find the First Strict Local Minimum
prompt: Implement `solution(nums)` to return the smallest index of a strict local minimum in an integer array. An interior element must be smaller than both neighbors. At an endpoint, compare with its one neighbor; a one-element array has a local minimum at index `0`. Return `-1` for an empty array or if no index qualifies. Explain the time and space costs.

example.reasoning: Indices 1 and 3 are local minima, so return the first.
